basics.name: Francisco Manuel Olmedo Cortés
basics.label: Physicist · building AI systems that ship
basics.summary: Physicist who builds AI systems for production. I use AI and simulations to solve real problems —from RAG pipelines and agents to multi-tenant backends— and I take them all the way to deployment. Partner and owner of the AI/ML domain at Hagalink: I turn ambiguous client problems into reliable, observable services.

work.name: Hagalink
highlights: Technical owner of the AI/ML domain across multiple client projects: I lead the decisions from discovery to product design, architecture and delivery.

I design and build a variety of AI systems —multi-tenant RAG backends, ingestion/analysis microservices, agents and automations— with NestJS, Python, PostgreSQL and vector databases, reusing my own components such as my open-source feedpulse.
Multi-channel ingestion (WhatsApp, Telegram, Web) and production deployment with observability.
Among the projects, the official chatbot for the Feria de Córdoba (Córdoba City Council), inheriting BlakIA's products and responsibilities.
Technical bridge with clients: I explain the trade-offs across accuracy, cost and latency.

work.name: Universidad de Córdoba / CIEMAT
highlights: Ongoing research in thermoluminescence dosimetry (TLD-100) with ML methods, continuing the line of my 2023 publication, in collaboration with Hagalink on the development side.
Results accepted for presentation at the Annual Meeting of the Spanish Nuclear Society (SNE), October 2026; enrolling in the doctoral programme in the next admission call.

work.name: BlakIA
highlights: Founded the company. Designed and implemented B2B Generative AI systems from scratch: RAG pipelines and autonomous agents for enterprise workflow automation.
Owned core architecture decisions, applying Lean methodologies and standardizing reusable components and project structure across client deployments.

Official chatbot for the Feria de Córdoba (Córdoba City Council) and the Cruz de Guía chatbot for Holy Week (Association of Córdoba Brotherhoods): public-facing assistants running through the festival peaks.
Recognised with the Emprende UCO award; accelerated at El Patio – Andalucía Open Future.
Transitioned products, clients and responsibilities into Hagalink.

work.name: Universidad de Córdoba (Confidential Project)
highlights: Refactored a legacy scientific simulator (ray tracing) applying Clean Architecture; introduced version control and good development practices in the group.
Built an optimizer based on Genetic Algorithms for the design of crystals (disordered optical media).

work.name: IDENER.AI
highlights: Applied Deep Learning models for time series forecasting to optimize energy production predictions.
Translated theoretical scientific requirements into efficient, functional code in a fast-paced R&D environment.

work.name: Universidad de Córdoba / CIEMAT
highlights: Developed a physical simulator based on the numerical resolution of differential equations (Runge-Kutta) in Python, deployed as a web tool via Streamlit.
Synthetic data generation: used the simulator as an 'oracle' to produce high-precision datasets for Deep Learning.
Designed and trained fully-connected neural networks for kinetic parameter assessment, resulting in a peer-reviewed publication.
Taught an introductory Python course for scientific computing, AI and data science.

education.score: Honors (Matrícula de Honor) in Bachelor Thesis

publications.name: Correlation between figure of merit function and deviation in the assessment of kinetic parameters in realistic TLD-100 behavior using fully-connected neural networks

projects.name: feedpulse
projects.description: RSS monitoring platform with hexagonal/DDD architecture — three runtimes (api/scheduler/worker), observability, queues, benchmarks and production-grade tests.

projects.name: Hybrid-RAG-example
projects.description: Teaching resource I built to train my students in production-grade Hybrid RAG — semantic + keyword retrieval fused with RRF, Clean Architecture.

projects.name: llm-pii-redactor
projects.description: Reference implementation of PII redaction at the AI-provider boundary: the app depends on an interface, and a redacting wrapper keeps personal data inside the backend. Written for GDPR-sensitive public-sector deployments.

projects.name: claudeops-tui
projects.description: Local TUI to track Claude Code usage, costs, and tasks (Go + Bubbletea + SQLite).

projects.name: snow-mcrt
projects.description: Monte Carlo photon transport for light in snow, written from first principles and validated against closed-form radiative transfer and published albedo benchmarks. 3-D engine with a Fresnel surface and measured detection of buried objects.
